nrb.body: Consult on WhatsApp and pay online; our local expert handles the site work.

items.a: No. LandDoctor is a private advisory service. Government applications follow government procedures.

items.q: Do you speed up government work?
items.a: No. We advise on the right documents and procedures, so you avoid unnecessary delays.
Site work is currently available in Savar and Gazipur. Phone consultations are available from anywhere, including abroad.
Yes, the first 10 minutes are free. If you wish to proceed, we send a written proposal.
Through the link in your proposal, by bKash, Nagad, Rocket or card.

items.q: How do I send my documents?
items.a: Send photos of the relevant documents on WhatsApp. We'll tell you which ones during the consultation.
Let us know within 7 days of delivery. We'll review it and correct the work, or refund under our refund policy.
